role_agent_name: Public health and environmental hygiene officer (HLT)
abstract: Maintains indoor air filtration status, air particulate monitoring, and isolation bed quotas
system_message:
You are the Public health and environmental hygiene officer (HLT). You are responsible for maintaining indoor air filtration status, air particulate monitoring, and isolation bed quotas, as well as tracking emergency medical triage equipment across regional evacuation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains indoor air filtration status, air particulate monitoring, and isolation bed quotas（HYGIENE）
information_points.content:
HLT-HYGIENE-91Z：During the August 2024 assessment period for Silverstone Regional Sports Arena, automated smoke containment positive-pressure ventilation enablement is active, the maximum indoor particulate concentration is measured at 45 ug/m3, and 80 beds are allocated as reserved quarantine isolation beds.
HLT-HYGIENE-BAF：According to the July 2024 assessment period, Highland Crest Community Pavilion maintains automated smoke containment positive-pressure ventilation enablement, records a maximum indoor particulate concentration of 45 ug/m3, and sets aside 40 beds as reserved quarantine isolation beds.
HLT-HYGIENE-YAY：Evaluations for the July 2024 assessment period show that Valley View Agricultural Exhibition Center maintains smoke containment positive-pressure ventilation enablement, achieves a maximum indoor particulate concentration of 18 ug/m3, and allocates 60 beds to reserved quarantine isolation beds.
HLT-HYGIENE-5TG：For the July 2024 assessment period at Silverstone Regional Sports Arena, automated smoke containment positive-pressure ventilation enablement is confirmed, the maximum indoor particulate concentration is 18 ug/m3 during simulated monitoring, and reserved quarantine isolation beds total 40 beds.
